title: Shark® ChillPill™ and Ninja CRISPi® DualZone Named to Oprah’s Favorite Things 2026 List
summary: Shark® ChillPill™ and Ninja CRISPi® DualZone Named to Oprah’s Favorite Things 2026 List. The latest on SharkNinja innovations—press releases, product launches, media kits, images, and press contacts.
body_markdown:
SharkNinja, Inc. (NYSE: SN), a global product design and consumer technology company, announced today that the Shark® ChillPill™ and Ninja CRISPi® DualZone are included in the


2026 ‘Oprah’s Favorite Things’ list,


featuring 79 unique gifts, including little luxuries, cozy comforts, clever finds for friends, family, and everyone in between

[SharkNinja.com](http://sharkninja.com/) .


Shark


**®** ChillPill


**™** is the only 3-in-1 personal cooling system designed to help you keep your cool, inside and out, whenever life heats up. ChillPill


**™** combines a high-speed bladeless fan that accelerates air up to 25 feet per second, a refreshing indoor-outdoor dry touch evaporative mister, and a cryo-inspired InstaChill™ direct contact cooling plate that lowers skin temperature by up to 16°F in seconds for customizable cooling and instant relief.


As Oprah says on OprahDaily.com, “I was in France for the hottest days—104 and 105 degrees. Everybody was walking around with this fan! It’s great for heat waves, but I’m also giving it to all my ‘hot flashing’ friends.”


Ninja CRISPi® DualZone is the first glass air fryer with DualZone Technology. Two independent 4-quart CleanCrisp™ glass zones run at different settings finishing both at the same time with Smart Finish® for a total of 8-quarts of cooking capacity. With six functions, Air Fry, Bake, Dehydrate, Max Crisp, Roast, and Recrisp, it offers more ways to meal prep, host or make meals for the whole family.


For Ninja CRISPi® DualZone, Oprah says on OprahDaily.com, “Two air fryers in one means meat on one side, veggies on the other. With Smart Finish tech, they’re ready at the same time. For anyone on dinner duty.”

The ‘Oprah’s Favorite Things’ podcast episode is available on Prime Video, FireTV Channels, Oprah’s YouTube Channel, Amazon Music, Spotify, Apple Podcasts and wherever you enjoy podcasts. Customers can also watch and shop the episode on Amazon Live, or the Amazon Live FAST channel, as well as through Prime Video’s ‘Shop the Show’, where customers can seamlessly shop the featured products.


[Shark ® ChillPill](https://www.sharkninja.com/shark-chillpill-3-in-1-personal-cooling-system-carbon/FA022.html?srsltid=AfmBOooEfTJFQo7EsW3ssOlhHbm-RsA5tr-1mb667B2fmuYmdKeXwHpo&dwvar_FA022_color=2D2C2D) **™** and
